scope: Qwen H4096/I1536 EP4 Decode, SwapAB M64/N128, non-reuse accumulation. No runtime/batch/topology change.
changes: Keep SwiGLU FP32 values in registers; share eight partial maxima per token, reduce the full group64 amax, then pack FP8 directly from registers.
Use pair-major partial-max layout without shared bank conflicts in the CPU address model; reuse consumed scratch for inverse scales.
Grant the math warpgroups 192 registers, within the existing 64512-register CTA budget; do not change static launch bounds or shared-memory allocation.
Load Qwen block128 FP32 weight scales cooperatively once per tile and broadcast by K index. FC1: 64 to 2 warp global-load instructions per tile; FC2: 12 to 1. Logical scale values unchanged.
preserved: all 64 activation values in each amax
FP8 conversion and FP32 SwiGLU inputs
costs: One extra CTA barrier per FC1 tile to share inverse scales.
Math warp allocation rises from 168 to 192; total role allocation 48640 to 54784, below 64512.
Compiled static instruction slots grow from 6536 to 6616 including padding; this is not a runtime instruction count or timing prediction.

compiler.toolchain: CUDA 12.9.86 / GCC 13 on Genkai login CPU

validation.patch_chain: Seven native patches applied to original pinned wheel; final bytes match CPU compilation.
validation.cpu_layout_model: All 0..64 live-row counts, unique value/scale ownership, paired scratch reuse, per-row amax and FP8 conversion-input bits.
validation.fp8_pack_cpu: 16385 finite FP8 pairs checked with CUDA headers and host C++; no CUDA device/runtime execution.
validation.future_gpu_gate: All eight widths, full tile/tail, live all-zero input, changing masked CUDA-graph inputs. Not run.

rejected_variants.loop_hoisting: About 30% static code growth; excluded from active build.
rejected_variants.register_quant_math_168: 32 B spill stores / 16 B loads; replaced by 192-register role allocation.
rejected_variants.warp_cooperative_quantizer: Compiled without spills; preserved in local evidence as the simpler alternative to register-resident quantization.

performance_status: Unmeasured. No 7200+ claim or GPU submission. The original profile lacks per-phase stall/duration evidence; the new extra barrier must be weighed against reduced shared traffic and dependent weight-scale loads.
